subject: Four new JTX packages, each one sized to a real truck
preheader: A 26 inch Ace on a lifted F-250, a six wheel dually set, and two more you can build on your own truck.
demo: Demo email for Chris. Not sent to customers. Every photo is a live render from the DROOOLY 3D builder.
headline: Four new wheel and tire packages, each one sized to a real truck
intro: We paired four JTX Forged wheels with the tire and lift height that fill them out right. Every photo here is that exact set at its real size on that truck, straight from our 3D builder. Tap one and it opens on your truck, where you can change the wheel, finish, tire or lift piece by piece.

hero.alt: Red 2022 Ford F-250 on 26 inch polished JTX Ace wheels and 37 inch tires, 4 inch lift
hero.cta: Put the Ace on my truck

packagesHeading: Start with the one closest to your truck and make it yours

packages.name: 24 inch JTX Alpha on a stock height F-450 dually
packages.blurb: Six forged Alpha wheels with the front and rear matched, and the dually rear offset already worked out. The truck stays at stock height, the way most people who tow want it.
packages.alt: White Ford F-450 dually on 24 inch polished JTX Alpha wheels

specs.v: JTX Forged Alpha 24x8.25, polished, set of six

packages.name: 24 inch JTX Capo on a 6 inch lifted Sierra 2500HD
packages.blurb: The split spoke Capo in brushed aluminum, against a black truck, on 35 inch mud terrains. The 14 inch width sets the wheels out toward the fender line for a wider stance.
packages.alt: Black GMC Sierra 2500HD on 24 inch brushed JTX Capo wheels, 6 inch lift

packages.name: 22 inch JTX Ballistic on a 2.5 inch lifted F-150
packages.blurb: Sixteen thin spokes in black milled, where the cut edges catch the light. A 35 inch all terrain suits a truck that spends more time on the highway than on the trail.
packages.alt: White Ford F-150 on 22 inch black milled JTX Ballistic wheels, 2.5 inch lift

addonsHeading: Three things worth adding while your set is being built

addons.title: Mounted and balanced
addons.text: We mount and balance the tires on your wheels before the set ships, so it bolts straight on when it arrives. It is priced on your quote, with freight on its own line.

addons.title: TPMS sensors
addons.text: Sensors programmed to your truck, so the tire pressure light stays off after the swap.

addons.title: Lug kit
addons.text: Spline drive lug nuts in black or chrome, matched to your bolt pattern and thread size.

closing: Fitment verified before we build it. Reply with your year, make and model, or a photo of your truck, and we will tell you which of these works and what it takes.
